# Ivy League Solutions

> Ivy League Solutions is a global software development company delivering custom software, fintech platforms, enterprise systems (ERP/CRM), and digital infrastructure for mid-to-large businesses. Headquartered in Perth Amboy, New Jersey, USA, with additional offices in Dubai, UAE, and Islamabad, Pakistan.

Ivy League Solutions builds industry-specific software for fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, logistics, and academia (EdTech), and delivers enterprise-wide digital transformation, cloud infrastructure, and API integration projects across industries. Engagements are scoped around measurable business outcomes rather than delivered code alone.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/services)
- [Custom Software Development](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke software, web & mobile apps, product modernization.
- [Enterprise Solutions & ERP](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/services/enterprise-solutions): Enterprise application integration, ERP/CRM (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics), BI & analytics.
- [Fintech & Digital Platforms](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/services/fintech-digital-platforms): Digital banking, micro-bank platforms, wallet applications, digital lending, core banking systems.
- [Digital Infrastructure & Cloud](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/services/digital-infrastructure): Cloud migration and managed infrastructure on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
- [API & Integration Services](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/services/api-integration): REST/GraphQL API development, third-party integration, system orchestration, data synchronization.
- [Digital Transformation](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/services/digital-transformation): Digital strategy, process automation, cloud adoption, data & insights.

## Industries

- [Industries overview](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/industries)
- [Fintech](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/industries/fintech): Payment platforms, mobile banking, lending systems, compliance engines.
- [Healthcare](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/industries/healthcare): HIPAA-compliant patient management, telemedicine, health records.
- [E-Commerce](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/industries/ecommerce): Multi-vendor marketplaces, inventory management, order processing.
- [Logistics](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/industries/logistics): Fleet tracking, warehouse management, supply chain optimization.
- [Academia (EdTech)](https://ivyleaguesolutions.com/industries/academia): Learning management systems, student portals, virtual classrooms.
